subject: Staggered TPM commit model — proposal & MAP milestones
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@virthq.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Staggered TPM commit model — initial MAP proposal

Emma —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a first-pass mutual action plan and a staggered commit proposal that aligns discounts to MAP milestone attainment. Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + acceptance criteria) and SOW-draft.pdf.

High-level proposal (preview):
- 90-day evaluation kickoff (pilot) with 2-week check-ins.
- Staggered monthly TPM commit approach: month 1 = 5M tokens, month 2 = 12M, month 3 = 25M, then steady-state 35M/month.
- Discount schedule tied to on-time ramp: 10% at month 1 milestone, 15% once steady-state reached by month 3; additional 3% rebate for meeting quality SLAs over quarter.
- If VirtuHQ prefers front-loaded capacity we can shift weighting but pricing and credit mechanics will change.

Ask: can you confirm whether procurement prefers quarterly POs or a single annual PO? Also confirm any compliance docs you need (SOC 2, DPA) and I’ll loop in our security contact.

Proposed next steps: review MAP_v1 with your PM and procurement, sync 30-45 minutes later this week for alignment.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones), SOW-draft.pdf (scope/assumptions)

From: Victor Yang <victor.yang@virthq.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Clark <emma.clark@virthq.com>, procurement@virthq.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered TPM commit model — initial MAP proposal

Sergio —

Thanks for the write-up and the files. A few quick clarifications from the product/procurement side:
1) We like the MAP milestones, but our finance team is pushing for a more front-loaded ramp for Q1—targeting roughly 60% of the committed volume within the first 90 days to support an aggressive feature launch.
2) Procurement prefers one PO per quarter, not monthly invoices. Is that compatible with a staggered TPM schedule?
3) We’ll need SOC 2 type II evidence and a signed DPA before we can route for approval — can you send that?

One more ask: if we agree to the front-load, what flexibility can you give on blended unit pricing for the first two quarters?

—
Victor Yang
VP Product, VirtuHQ
victor.yang@virthq.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Staggered TPM commit model — pricing sensitivity

Sergio / Laura —

Read Victor’s note. If they front-load 60% in Q1 we can accommodate but pricing needs to be adjusted to protect margin. Proposed counter (attached pricing_matrix_v2.csv):
- Front-load uplift: +8% unit price on months where committed >40% of quarterly volume unless payment is received upfront.
- Early ramp discount tiers: 0–50% attainment = no extra rebate; 50–80% attainment = 5% retro rebate; 80%+ attainment = 10% retro rebate.
- Additional concession: one-time onboarding credit (applied against first invoice) if they sign within 10 business days.

If we give >15% list discount we need Laura’s approval for exception. Also we should confirm credit terms if they miss ramp milestones (we typically offer usage credits, not cash refunds).

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v2.csv

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@virthq.com>, Victor Yang <victor.yang@virthq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@virthq.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered TPM commit model — proposal & MAP milestones

Victor / Emma —

Appreciate the transparency on the front-load. After talking with RevOps and Legal, here’s a concise counter-proposal that attempts to meet you halfway:

Counter-proposal highlights:
- Commit shape: 50% of the agreed quarterly tokens delivered in first 60 days, then ramp to steady-state by month 3 (target monthly TPMs: M1=18M, M2=12M, M3=35M thereafter — see attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx).
- Billing cadence: quarterly PO is fine; invoices issued monthly with consolidated quarterly invoice available for accounting.
- Pricing: accept front-load with a blended effective price (we apply a 6% front-load premium on months where monthly usage > committed threshold) but provide a retro rebate up to 7% if they meet 90%+ of quarterly committed TPM.
- Missed milestones: we offer usage credit equal to 10% of the missed month's invoice (credit applied to next invoice) for missed ramp milestones, not cash refunds.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and DPA are available; I’ve started the request with security.

I’ve included a DocuSign link for the SOW + MAP (https://docusign.example/start/abc123). If this looks ok to you, let’s do a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize and I’ll route the SOW for signature.

Next steps for VirtuHQ: confirm PO cadence (quarterly), confirm acceptance of credit mechanics, and nominate an internal MAP owner to track milestones.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP_v1.1.xlsx

From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@virthq.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Yang <victor.yang@virthq.com>, procurement@virthq.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2026 16:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered TPM commit model — proposal & MAP milestones

Sergio —

Thanks for the thoughtful counter-proposal. VirtuHQ is prepared to move forward with your proposed compromise:
- We accept the 50% front-load in the first 60 days and the quarterly PO cadence.
- We accept the credit mechanics (usage credits for missed milestones) and the retro rebate structure tied to quarterly attainment.
- Procurement will initiate the first quarterly PO after we complete the DocuSign signature for the SOW.

I’ve attached a short signed intent (Signed-Intent.pdf) and Victor will be the MAP owner internally. Can you confirm SOC 2 Type II evidence and start the DPA routing?

Let’s schedule a 30-minute call Monday to finalize language and confirm signature timeline. I’m available 10–11am PT.

—
Emma Clark
Head of Product Operations, VirtuHQ
emma.clark@virthq.com | +1 212-555-0147

Attachments: Signed-Intent.pdf
